worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.summary: Hurl a whirlpool to the target's feet and anchor it where it landed: it drags enemies in the pool back toward the eye, keeps drowning them and slows those caught. It pins no one, but no one leaves the water easily; a knockback out of the pool or the water running out ends it. The mire style is wider, stickier and longer but drowns softer; the torrent style is tighter, shorter and drowns harder.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.use.0: Drag a fleeing target back into the fight again and again
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.use.1: Close off a retreat or a doorway
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.use.2: Wear down a stubborn melee target with steady drowning
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.use.3: Slow a target so an ally can close in
The water jet deals %1$s special damage and raises a dragging whirlpool at the target's feet.
The whirlpool lasts %1$s, pulling targets in the pool %2$s blocks toward the eye each beat and drowning them every %3$s.
Being dragged past %1$s blocks from the eye breaks it free; those caught are slowed by %2$s stage(s); range %3$s blocks, jet speed %4$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.option.on: Mire style on: pool x1.3, pull x1.15, duration x1.15, cooldown +8, but drown power x0.85, holding a target in the water far longer.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.option.off: Mire style off (torrent): smaller pool, weaker pull, shorter duration and cooldown, full drown power, made to hit and leave.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.growth.0: At level %1$s the drown power rises to %2$s and the current lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.preference.m: On: wider pool, tighter pull, longer duration, cooldown +8, but drown power x0.85, holding a target in the water far longer. Off: smaller pool, weaker pull, shorter duration and cooldown, full drown power, made to hit and leave.
worldcombat.skill.whirlpool.preference.a: Only consider a whirlpool on a threat within this distance; lower it to spin water only up close, raise it to tie a target down from farther away.
On: only spin water on a moving or fleeing threat, taking away its mobility first; off: willing to spin on any threat in range.
